title: Create SKILL.md agent-facing documentation
description: Create .claude/skills/agent-memory/SKILL.md with the required YAML frontmatter (name, description, tools, user-invocable: true) and body sections: Getting Started (how to locate memory.py), When to use this skill (bead start/end patterns and post-feature ingest), Commands reference (one paragraph per command with full CLI signature), DB path conventions (default location, --db flag, per-project vs shared), and What NOT to store (mirrors docs/memory/conventions.md guidance on ephemeral state and CLAUDE.md content).
acceptance_criteria: Frontmatter contains name, description, tools, and user-invocable fields
Body contains a 'When to use this skill' section
Body contains a 'Commands reference' section covering init, add, search, delete, list, stats, and ingest
